=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 14 November 2015. The Facebook photo viewer names Ryan Werntz. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 13 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (Gainesville, Va). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/rwerntz and lists Lives in Bristow, Virginia, a Prince William County neighbor of Gainesville. The uncropped original is Werntz with an unlabeled infant; the lead crop is Werntz alone. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Ryan Werntz portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Ryan Werntz Facebook portrait.jpg]].
